proves.claim: agentSession keeps PULLBOARD_AGENT_PID first and startClaimBeater records a beater under an ancestor another live beater watches as shared.

cli.io-beater.worker-not-ancestor.why: Without it, many seats could all depend only on one long-lived ancestor's pid and their beaters would outlive their workers.

proves.claim: runBeater stops and drops its lock after the quiet interval with no board event and no folder change, and keeps beating while either is recent.

cli.io-beater.quiet-seat-stops.why: Without it, a seat whose worker exited could show presence live indefinitely behind a long-lived ancestor.
